sm.$description: Small corner radius for compact controls: inputs, checkboxes, tooltips.

md.$description: Default corner radius for buttons, alerts, and mid-size containers.

lg.$description: Large corner radius for cards, dialogs, and prominent containers.

full.$description: Fully rounded corners for pills, badges, and circular controls.

1.$description: Standard border width for inputs, cards, and separators.

2.$description: Emphasized border width for focus indicators and selected states.
